{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin for using ChatGPT Plus/Pro Codex models through OpenAI Codex OAuth.","id":"gh:1334667536","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-codex-oauth","slug":"eons2long/dsh-codex-oauth","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin for using ChatGPT Plus/Pro Codex models through OpenAI Codex OAuth."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-codex-oauth"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Use ChatGPT plan models in DeepSeek Harness through OpenAI's direct OAuth integration. Version 0.3 i"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"mplements DSH's official `LlmAdapter` directly and has no `pi-ai` or `dsh-llm-pi-ai` dependency."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The plugin handles browser authorization, account selection, rotating token refresh, current account"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" model discovery, and Responses streaming. It translates DSH tools, images and conversation history,"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" and preserves completed encrypted reasoning for subsequent turns. Filesystem access, tool execution"},{"id":"p5s4","text":", permissions and context compaction remain DSH responsibilities."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Requirements and installation"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Requires Node.js 22 or newer and DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` compatible `dsh-llm` and `dsh-atomic-write` packag"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"es. Version 0.3 no longer supports the old DSH 0.1 adapter contract."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Install into the profile you actually run:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"For a source checkout:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"For the Web surface, use `--profile web` and launch `dsh web`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Installing the archive also avoids pnpm reusing an older local directory's file list when upgrading "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"an existing source installation."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"If the TUI profile also loads its built-in subscription OAuth module, exclude `openai-codex` from `d"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"sh-tui-auth` so this plugin owns that provider. In `$DSH_HOME/profiles/dsh-tui/cordis.patch.yml` (de"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"fault `~/.dsh/profiles/dsh-tui/cordis.patch.yml`):"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Preserve any existing `credentialsFile` and `modelOverrides` in that block. Retain only providers su"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"pported by your installed TUI. Restart the profile after upgrading the plugin."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Sign in and choose a model"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Authorize the application in the browser and allow ChatGPT plan usage. The local callback binds to `"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"127.0.0.1:1455`, falling back to another loopback port when necessary. This flow requires browser au"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"thorization; `--device-code` is unavailable."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"In the Web UI, open **Settings → OpenAI Codex**, select **Continue with ChatGPT**, and return after "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"authorization. The section offers account selection, cancellation, sign-out, model refresh and a man"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"age usage link. Identity-only authorization is shown separately; sign in again to authorize plan usa"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" usage link. Identity-only authorization is shown separately; sign in again to authorize plan usage."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Choose provider `openai-codex` in DSH's model picker. Models come from the selected account's live c"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"atalog, including new releases such as GPT-6.1 Sol when the account has access. The plugin preserves"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" the server's display names and ordering, caches the catalog for five minutes, and supports explicit"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" refresh. It does not maintain a fixed model list."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Accounts and credentials"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Each account retains its issued application registration. Reauthorization reuses that registration a"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"nd verifies the same identity. Sign-out attempts remote revocation, clears the selected account's lo"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"cal tokens and keeps the registration for later sign-in. It leaves other accounts intact. Cancelling"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" a pending login preserves the previous account."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Credentials are stored in `$DSH_HOME/.openai-codex-auth.v2.json`, defaulting to `~/.dsh/.openai-code"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"x-auth.v2.json`. The versioned document keeps a stable host identifier, account registrations and th"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"e active selection. Writes are atomic; the directory is owner-only and the file is `0600` on POSIX. "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"A cross-process lock serializes token rotation. Temporary refresh failures preserve credentials; ter"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"minal refresh failures clear expired authorization."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"**Upgrade from 0.2:** sign in again using the new authorization flow. Legacy `.openai-codex-auth.jso"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"n` credentials cannot authorize this API route and are left untouched. The plugin never imports or c"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"hanges `~/.pi/agent/auth.json` or `~/.codex/auth.json`."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Supported behavior and limits"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Requests use `https://api.openai.com/v1/responses` with OAuth, `store: false`, `stream: true` and th"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"e required history in `input`. No API key is required. Usage is subject to ChatGPT plan eligibility "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"and application quotas; the plugin never falls back to API key billing."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"DSH's session identity supplies stable `session-id` and `x-client-request-id` headers for ordinary a"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"nd compaction calls. This preserves the gateway's session affinity for prompt-cache reuse; cache hit"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"s are still not guaranteed. Calls without a session identity omit these headers."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- DSH function tools run locally, grouped in a Responses namespace. All offered definitions are sent"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"; native Responses `tool_search` is unavailable on this route.
- Text and images use DSH attachments"},{"id":"p30s3","text":". Files and offloaded images are represented by local handles for DSH tools; this plugin does not up"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"load files to OpenAI's Files API.
- Reasoning effort and context metadata come from the live catalog"},{"id":"p30s5","text":" when advertised. Replay state is reused only for unchanged blocks from the same model and account. "},{"id":"p30s6","text":"Compacted or edited messages use the remaining DSH history.
- `temperature`, `maxTokens` and `stop` "},{"id":"p30s7","text":"fail with `UNSUPPORTED_OPTION` when set, because this ChatGPT plan route does not support them. Leav"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"e them unset in your agent configuration.
- DSH history summarization (`purpose: compaction`) accept"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"s the `maxTokens` budget supplied automatically by its compaction backend and omits it from the API "},{"id":"p30s10","text":"request. Automatic and manual DSH compaction can run, but the backend's summary output cap is not en"},{"id":"p30s11","text":"forced by this route. The existing history prefix is preserved before the appended summarization ins"},{"id":"p30s12","text":"truction.
- Only a completed response is successful. Usage-limit failures, incomplete responses and "},{"id":"p30s13","text":"interrupted streams have distinct failure semantics. Account quotas stop retries; transient provider"},{"id":"p30s14","text":" failures use DSH's retry policy.
- Hosted Responses image generation, file search, Code Interpreter"},{"id":"p30s15","text":", computer use, MCP and audio/video are outside this adapter. Local DSH capabilities remain availabl"},{"id":"p30s16","text":"e as function tools."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"See OpenAI's current preview limitations."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### Quota display"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Web settings show English remaining-quota bars and reset timestamps. The TUI status line shows a com"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"pact summary; `/codex-usage` expands all available windows and their last-update times. Windows are "},{"id":"p34s3","text":"labeled by the server's duration (300 minutes is 5h, 10,080 minutes is Weekly), not their primary/se"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"rver's duration (300 minutes is 5h, 10,080 minutes is Weekly), not their primary/secondary position."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":true}
